_about: Vendor keywords for the anonymous report's 'seen' section. A service, startup entry, scheduled task or process is reported (by name, never by path) only when one of its words, or its vendor folder under Program Files / ProgramData, matches a keyword here. Short keywords (4 letters or fewer) must equal a whole word; longer ones may also start a word. Shared by the app (src-tauri/src/discovery.rs) and the server (server/src/model.rs), which re-checks every row.
